dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 02, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Pirates' Sweep of Phillies Marks a Thrilling Start to the Week**

In a dominating performance, the Pittsburgh Pirates took down the Philadelphia Phillies 6-1, led by Jared Jones' 4.0 innings of work, striking out 6 and allowing just 1 earned run. Meanwhile, Nick Gonzales continued his impressive season with a 3-hit, 2-RBI performance, including a 4th home run of the year. Elsewhere, the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Milwaukee Brewers 7-2 behind Jacob Misiorowski's 5.0 innings of 10-strikeout shutball, while the Colorado Rockies pounded out 14 runs against the Miami Marlins in a 14-4 blowout.
